 # ===========================================================================
-# SELF-HOSTING — the Rust/Elixir text backend, written in Rian
+# SELF-HOSTING — the Rust text backend (whole module), written in Rian
 # ===========================================================================
-# Goal (ADR-0063 §2 backend rung; ADR-0049/0055): emit source text from the Core
-# IR for BOTH text targets `Rian.Lower` serves — Rust and Elixir. The emitter is
-# **precedence-aware**: it threads each node's precedence and adds a paren only
-# when a child binds looser than its context (`Rian.Lower`'s `emit/2 ->
-# {string, prec}` + `p/3`). The precedence/associativity tables are shared across
-# targets; only the operator *spelling* (`disp`/`udisp`) and a few node *shapes*
-# (`if`, tuple, list) differ — exactly the split `Rian.Lower` itself makes. This
-# is the Rian-written counterpart, fixpoint-locked against
-# `Rian.Lower.emit_expr(_, :rust)` AND `(_, :elixir)` in
-# `test/rian/rust_emit_fixpoint_test.exs`.
+# Goal (ADR-0063 §2 backend rung; ADR-0049/0055/0061): emit a whole Rust module
+# from the IR — the Rian-written counterpart of `Rian.Lower.rust_program`'s
+# emission, fixpoint-locked against it in `test/rian/rust_module_fixpoint_test.exs`.
 #
-# Slice: literals, prefix unary (`-`/`not`), binary operators (full precedence/
-# associativity), calls, `if`, tuples, and closed lists — for both targets. The
-# `:partial` tail (ADR-0063 / docs/self-host-status.md): dot (Rust `::`-vs-`.`
-# disambiguation), cons-lists (the Rust `to_vec`/insert prepend), structs, `case`,
-# maps, and atoms (BEAM-only on Rust).
+# Rust dispatches multi-clause functions with a `match` over the tuple of params;
+# sum types become `enum`s. The emitter is precedence-aware (the reference's
+# `emit/2 -> {string, prec}` + `p/3`). The stage consumes Core that is already
+# RESOLVED (variant construction -> `Enum::Ctor`, ctor patterns carry their enum)
+# and capability-LOWERED (params carry their Rust type) — resolution is the
+# parser/Core stage's job and capability lowering is the (self-hosted) capability
+# stage's. Generics (parametric tvars + owned↔borrow coercion), iso/cons lists,
+# String-return coercion, structs/maps, and the Elixir text target are out of
+# scope (the corpus is non-generic, non-cons).
 # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 mod SelfhostRust do
-  # which text target to spell for (the reference's `:rust` / `:elixir` tag).
-  type Target := TRust | TElixir
-
   type Core := CNum(String)
              | CStr(String)
              | CId(String)
@@ -31,15 +25,157 @@ mod SelfhostRust do
              | CCall(String, Vec(Core))
              | CIf(Core, Core, Core)
              | CTuple(Vec(Core))
-             | CList(Vec(Core))
+             | COk(Core)
+             | CErr(Core)
+             | CVariant(String, String, Bool, Vec(VPair))
+
+  type VPair := VP(String, Core)
+
+  # resolved patterns (ctor patterns carry their enum/ctor/named + labels).
+  type RPat := RWild
+             | RVar(String)
+             | RInt(Int53)
+             | RStr(String)
+             | RCtorP(String, String, Bool, Vec(String), Vec(RPat))
+             | RTupleP(Vec(RPat))
+             | ROkP(RPat)
+             | RErrP(RPat)
+
+  type Guard := GNone | GSome(Core)
+  type Param := Param(String, String)
+  type Clause := Clause(Vec(RPat), Guard, Core)
+  type Func := Func(String, Bool, Vec(Param), String, Vec(Clause))
+  type EVar := EVar(String, Vec(String), Bool, Vec(String))
+  type EnumDef := EnumDef(String, Vec(EVar))
 
-  # An emitted fragment with its precedence (the reference's `{string, prec}`).
   struct Em(s String, pr Int53)
 
+  pub def compile_prog(enums Vec(EnumDef), funcs Vec(Func)) String :=
+    join_nn(enum_decls(enums), fn_decls(funcs))
+
+  def join_nn(String, String) String
+  def join_nn("", b) := b
+  def join_nn(a, "") := a
+  def join_nn(a, b) := a <> "\n\n" <> b
+
+  # ── sum type -> enum ──
+  def enum_decls(Vec(EnumDef)) String
+  def enum_decls([]) := ""
+  def enum_decls([e]) := enum_decl(e)
+  def enum_decls([e | rest]) := enum_decl(e) <> "\n\n" <> enum_decls(rest)
+
+  def enum_decl(EnumDef) String
+  def enum_decl(EnumDef(name, variants)) :=
+    "#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]\nenum " <> name <> " {\n" <> variant_lines(variants) <> "}"
+
+  def variant_lines(Vec(EVar)) String
+  def variant_lines([]) := ""
+  def variant_lines([v | rest]) := "    " <> variant_decl(v) <> ",\n" <> variant_lines(rest)
+
+  # `true`/`false` are variable patterns in a clause head, so dispatch on `named`
+  # with `if`, not literal clauses.
+  def variant_decl(EVar) String
+  def variant_decl(EVar(ctor, [], _, _)) := ctor
+  def variant_decl(EVar(ctor, types, named, labels))
+    if named do
+      ctor <> " { " <> named_fields(labels, types) <> " }"
+    else
+      ctor <> "(" <> comma_join(types) <> ")"
+    end
+  end
+
+  def named_fields(Vec(String), Vec(String)) String
+  def named_fields([], _) := ""
+  def named_fields([l], [t]) := l <> ": " <> t
+  def named_fields([l | ls], [t | ts]) := l <> ": " <> t <> ", " <> named_fields(ls, ts)
+
+  def comma_join(Vec(String)) String
+  def comma_join([]) := ""
+  def comma_join([s]) := s
+  def comma_join([s | rest]) := s <> ", " <> comma_join(rest)
+
+  # ── functions / match dispatch ──
+  def fn_decls(Vec(Func)) String
+  def fn_decls([]) := ""
+  def fn_decls([f]) := function_rs(f)
+  def fn_decls([f | rest]) := function_rs(f) <> "\n\n" <> fn_decls(rest)
+
+  # `rust_program` emits plain `fn` for every top-level function (a single Rust
+  # module; the `pub?` flag is not a Rust visibility here), so it is ignored.
+  def function_rs(Func) String
+  def function_rs(Func(name, _, params, ret, clauses)) :=
+    "fn " <> name <> "(" <> param_decls(params) <> ") -> " <> ret <> " {\n    match " <>
+      scrut(params) <> " {\n" <> arms(clauses) <> "    }\n}"
+
+  def param_decls(Vec(Param)) String
+  def param_decls([]) := ""
+  def param_decls([Param(n, t)]) := n <> ": " <> t
+  def param_decls([Param(n, t) | rest]) := n <> ": " <> t <> ", " <> param_decls(rest)
+
+  # one param matches directly; N>1 match the tuple of params.
+  def scrut(Vec(Param)) String
+  def scrut([Param(n, _)]) := n
+  def scrut(params) := "(" <> param_names(params) <> ")"
+
+  def param_names(Vec(Param)) String
+  def param_names([]) := ""
+  def param_names([Param(n, _)]) := n
+  def param_names([Param(n, _) | rest]) := n <> ", " <> param_names(rest)
+
+  def arms(Vec(Clause)) String
+  def arms([]) := ""
+  def arms([c | rest]) := arm(c) <> arms(rest)
+
+  def arm(Clause) String
+  def arm(Clause(pats, guard, body)) :=
+    "        " <> arm_pat(pats) <> guard_str(guard) <> " => " <> render(body) <> ",\n"
+
+  # one pattern matches directly; N>1 a tuple pattern.
+  def arm_pat(Vec(RPat)) String
+  def arm_pat([p]) := rpat(p)
+  def arm_pat(ps) := "(" <> rpat_list(ps) <> ")"
+
+  def rpat_list(Vec(RPat)) String
+  def rpat_list([]) := ""
+  def rpat_list([p]) := rpat(p)
+  def rpat_list([p | rest]) := rpat(p) <> ", " <> rpat_list(rest)
+
+  def guard_str(Guard) String
+  def guard_str(GNone) := ""
+  def guard_str(GSome(g)) := " if " <> render(g)
+
+  # ── resolved patterns -> Rust ──
+  def rpat(RPat) String
+  def rpat(RWild) := "_"
+  def rpat(RVar(n)) := n
+  def rpat(RInt(v)) := Prim.int_to_string(v)
+  def rpat(RStr(s)) := "\"" <> s <> "\""
+  def rpat(ROkP(p)) := "Ok(" <> rpat(p) <> ")"
+  def rpat(RErrP(p)) := "Err(" <> rpat(p) <> ")"
+  def rpat(RTupleP(ps)) := "(" <> rpat_list(ps) <> ")"
+  def rpat(RCtorP(enum, ctor, named, labels, args)) := ctor_pat(enum, ctor, named, labels, args)
+
+  def ctor_pat(enum String, ctor String, named Bool, labels Vec(String), args Vec(RPat)) String
+    if named do
+      enum <> "::" <> ctor <> " { " <> named_pats(labels, args) <> " }"
+    else
+      enum <> "::" <> ctor <> pos_pat_args(args)
+    end
+  end
+
+  # a nullary ctor pattern is `Enum::Ctor` (no parens); positional args add `(…)`.
+  def pos_pat_args(Vec(RPat)) String
+  def pos_pat_args([]) := ""
+  def pos_pat_args(args) := "(" <> rpat_list(args) <> ")"
+
+  def named_pats(Vec(String), Vec(RPat)) String
+  def named_pats([], _) := ""
+  def named_pats([l], [p]) := l <> ": " <> rpat(p)
+  def named_pats([l | ls], [p | ps]) := l <> ": " <> rpat(p) <> ", " <> named_pats(ls, ps)
+
+  # ── expression emission (precedence-aware) ──
   def dq(s String) String := "\"" <> s <> "\""

-  def udisp("not", TRust) := "!"
-  def udisp("not", TElixir) := "not "
-  def udisp("-", _) := "-"
-
-  # Wrap a fragment in parens iff it binds looser than the context (`pr < ctx`).
+  def disp(String) String
+  def disp("and") := "&&"
+  def disp("or") := "||"
+  def disp("div") := "/"
+  def disp("rem") := "%"
+  def disp(other) := other
+
+  def udisp(String) String
+  def udisp("not") := "!"
+  def udisp("-") := "-"
+
   def paren(e Em, ctx Int53) String
     if e.pr < ctx do
       "(" <> e.s <> ")"
@@ -94,72 +222,62 @@ mod SelfhostRust do

-  # Emit a node to a fragment + precedence (leaf = 12, unary = 11, `if` = 0).
-  pub def emit(Core, Target) Em
-  pub def emit(CNum(t), _) := Em(s: t, pr: 12)
-  pub def emit(CStr(s), _) := Em(s: dq(s), pr: 12)
-  pub def emit(CId(n), _) := Em(s: n, pr: 12)
-  pub def emit(CUnary(op, x), t) := Em(s: udisp(op, t) <> paren(emit(x, t), 11), pr: 11)
-  pub def emit(CBin(op, l, r), t) := bin_em(op, l, r, t)
-  # a call `f(a, b)` binds tightest (prec 12); each argument is a full expression
-  # rendered at context 0 (comma-self-delimited, never parenthesised).
-  pub def emit(CCall(f, args), t) := Em(s: f <> "(" <> args_str(args, t) <> ")", pr: 12)
-  # `if` is prec 0; its cond/then/else render at context 0. Rust uses braces,
-  # Elixir `do … else … end`.
-  pub def emit(CIf(c, th, el), t) := Em(s: if_str(c, th, el, t), pr: 0)

+defmodule Rian.RustModuleFixpointTest do
+  # async: false — loads a real module into the VM via :code.load_binary.
+  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
+
+  alias Rian.{Beam, Capability, Core, Decl, Lower, Pratt}
+
+  # Self-hosting fixpoint (ADR-0063) for the **Rust text backend** (whole module):
+  # a Rian-written port of `Rian.Lower.rust_program`'s emission
+  # (examples/rian/selfhost_rust.rian), compiled to real `.beam`, diffed against
+  # `Rian.Lower.rust_program` over a corpus — sum types → `enum`s, functions with
+  # `match`-tuple multi-clause dispatch, operators, `if`, variant construct+match.
+  #
+  # The emitter consumes RESOLVED + capability-LOWERED Core: this test does the
+  # upstream work (parse, build the ctor→enum meta, `Rian.Capability.rust_param`,
+  # resolve variant construction/patterns) and injects, then the port emits the
+  # module. Generics, iso/cons lists, String-returns, structs/maps, and the Elixir
+  # target are out of scope (the corpus is non-generic, non-cons).
+
+  setup_all do
+    {:ok, mod} =
+      Beam.load(File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_rust.rian"), :rian_rust_module_fixpoint)
+
+    {:ok, mod: mod}
+  end
+
+  # ctor (snake) -> %{enum, ctor, named, labels} over a program's sum types.
+  defp build_meta(types) do
+    for t <- types, v <- t.variants, into: %{} do
+      labels = Enum.map(v.fields, & &1.label)
+      named = v.fields != [] and Enum.all?(labels, & &1)
+
+      {Rian.PatternLower.to_snake(v.ctor),
+       %{enum: t.name, ctor: v.ctor, named: named, labels: labels}}
+    end
+  end
+
+  # ── resolved body Core -> the port's Core ──
+  defp ic(%Core.EBlock{stmts: [{:expr, e}]}, m), do: ic(e, m)
+  defp ic(%Core.ENum{text: t}, _), do: {:c_num, t}
+  defp ic(%Core.EStr{value: v}, _), do: {:c_str, v}
+  defp ic(%Core.EUnary{op: op, arg: a}, m), do: {:c_unary, op, ic(a, m)}
+  defp ic(%Core.EBin{op: op, left: l, right: r}, m), do: {:c_bin, op, ic(l, m), ic(r, m)}
+
+  defp ic(%Core.EIf{cond: c, then: t, else: e}, m),
+    do: {:c_if, ic(c, m), ibranch(t, m), ibranch(e, m)}
+
+  defp ic(%Core.ETuple{elems: [%Core.EAtom{name: "ok"}, v]}, m), do: {:c_ok, ic(v, m)}
+  defp ic(%Core.ETuple{elems: [%Core.EAtom{name: "error"}, e]}, m), do: {:c_err, ic(e, m)}
+  defp ic(%Core.ETuple{elems: es}, m), do: {:c_tuple, Enum.map(es, &ic(&1, m))}
+
+  defp ic(%Core.ECall{fun: %Core.EId{name: f}, args: args}, m) do
+    if pascal?(f),
+      do: variant(f, Enum.map(args, fn a -> {"", a} end), m),
+      else: {:c_call, f, Enum.map(args, &ic(&1, m))}
+  end
+
+  defp ic(%Core.EId{name: n}, m), do: if(pascal?(n), do: variant(n, [], m), else: {:c_id, n})
+
+  defp ibranch(%Core.EBlock{stmts: [{:expr, e}]}, m), do: ic(e, m)
+  defp ibranch(e, m), do: ic(e, m)
+
+  defp variant(ctor, lab_vals, m) do
+    info = Map.fetch!(m, Rian.PatternLower.to_snake(ctor))
+    pairs = Enum.map(lab_vals, fn {l, v} -> {:vp, l, ic(v, m)} end)
+    {:c_variant, info.enum, info.ctor, info.named, pairs}
+  end
+
+  # ── resolved pattern -> the port's RPat ──
+  defp rp(%Core.PWild{}, _), do: :r_wild
+  defp rp(%Core.PVar{name: n}, _), do: {:r_var, n}
+  defp rp(%Core.PLit{value: v}, _) when is_integer(v), do: {:r_int, v}
+  defp rp(%Core.PLit{value: v}, _) when is_binary(v), do: {:r_str, v}
+  defp rp(%Core.PTuple{elems: [%Core.PAtom{name: "ok"}, p]}, m), do: {:r_ok_p, rp(p, m)}
+  defp rp(%Core.PTuple{elems: [%Core.PAtom{name: "error"}, p]}, m), do: {:r_err_p, rp(p, m)}
+  defp rp(%Core.PTuple{elems: ps}, m), do: {:r_tuple_p, Enum.map(ps, &rp(&1, m))}
+
+  defp rp(%Core.PCtor{ctor: c, args: args}, m) do
+    info = Map.fetch!(m, Rian.PatternLower.to_snake(c))
+    {:r_ctor_p, info.enum, info.ctor, info.named, info.labels || [], Enum.map(args, &rp(&1, m))}
+  end
+
+  defp pascal?(<<c, _::binary>>), do: c in ?A..?Z
+
+  # ── IR -> the port's program shape ──
+  defp ienum(t) do
+    vs =
+      Enum.map(t.variants, fn v ->
+        labels = Enum.map(v.fields, & &1.label)
+        named = v.fields != [] and Enum.all?(labels, & &1)
+        {:e_var, v.ctor, Enum.map(v.fields, &Capability.owned(&1.type)), named, labels}
+      end)
+
+    {:enum_def, t.name, vs}
+  end
+
+  defp ifunc(f, m) do
+    params =
+      Enum.map(f.params, fn p -> {:param, p.name, Capability.rust_param(p.cap, p.type)} end)
+
+    clauses =
+      Enum.map(f.clauses, fn c ->
+        pats = Enum.map(c.pats, fn p -> rp(Core.from_pat(p), m) end)
+
+        guard =
+          if c.guard, do: {:g_some, ic(Core.from_expr(Pratt.parse(c.guard)), m)}, else: :g_none
+
+        body = ic(Core.from_expr(Pratt.parse_body(c.body)), m)
+        {:clause, pats, guard, body}
+      end)
+
+    {:func, f.name, Map.get(f, :pub?, false), params, Capability.owned(f.ret), clauses}
+  end
+
+  defp ported(mod, src) do
+    prog = src |> Decl.parse() |> Rian.Opaque.erase()
+    m = build_meta(prog.types)
+    funcs = prog.funcs |> Enum.reject(& &1.dispatch)
+    mod.compile_prog(Enum.map(prog.types, &ienum/1), Enum.map(funcs, fn f -> ifunc(f, m) end))
+  end
+
+  @corpus [
+    "def add(a Int64, b Int64) Int64 := a + b",
+    "def neg(a Int64) Int64 := -a",
+    "def cmp(a Int64, b Int64) Bool := a < b and a != b",
+    "def quot(a Int64, b Int64) Int64 := a div b rem a",
+    "def maxi(a Int64, b Int64) Int64 := if a > b do a else b end",
+    "def fib(n Int64) Int64\ndef fib(0) := 0\ndef fib(1) := 1\ndef fib(n) := fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)",
+    "def sign(n Int64) Int64\ndef sign(0) := 0\ndef sign(n) when n > 0 := 1\ndef sign(_) := -1",
+    # sum type -> enum; variant construct + ctor-pattern match
+    "type Opt := None | Some(Int64)\npub def mk(n Int64) Opt\ndef mk(0) := None\ndef mk(n) := Some(n)",
+    "type Opt := None | Some(Int64)\npub def get(o Opt, d Int64) Int64\ndef get(None, d) := d\ndef get(Some(v), _) := v",
+    "type RGB := Red | Green | Blue\npub def code(c RGB) Int64\ndef code(Red) := 1\ndef code(Green) := 2\ndef code(Blue) := 3"
+  ]
+
+  describe "self-hosting Rust-module fixpoint — Rian emitter vs Rian.Lower.rust_program" do
+    test "the Rian-emitted Rust module equals Rian.Lower.rust_program exactly", %{mod: mod} do
+      for src <- @corpus do
+        assert ported(mod, src) == Lower.rust_program(Decl.parse(src)),
+               "Rust module diverged on:\n#{src}"
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "teeth — enums, match dispatch, and capability-lowered signatures are real" do
+    test "a sum type emits a derive'd enum; a val param borrows (&Opt)", %{mod: mod} do
+      out =
+        ported(
+          mod,
+          "type Opt := None | Some(Int64)\ndef get(o Opt, d Int64) Int64\ndef get(None, d) := d\ndef get(Some(v), _) := v"
+        )
+
+      assert out =~ "#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]\nenum Opt {"
+      assert out =~ "o: &Opt"
+      assert out =~ "Opt::Some(v)"
+    end
+
+    test "multi-clause dispatch is a match over the param tuple", %{mod: mod} do
+      out =
+        ported(mod, "def add(a Int64, b Int64) Int64\ndef add(0, b) := b\ndef add(a, b) := a + b")
+
+      assert out =~ "match (a, b) {"
+      assert out =~ "(0, b) =>"
+    end
+
+    test "discriminates structure", %{mod: mod} do
+      refute ported(mod, "def f(a Int64, b Int64) Int64 := a + b") ==
+               ported(mod, "def f(a Int64, b Int64) Int64 := a - b")
+    end
+  end
+end
